text.en:
The sum of sixty-two hundred and fifty pesos and sixty-three centavos is hereby appropriated,
out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the payment of the expenses incurred
by the Province of Surigao for the construction of a provincial jail and subsistence, medicines, and
transportation for the so-called "colorum" prisoners arrested in various parts of said province, during the first
months of the year nineteen hundred and twenty-four.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 25, 1924.
